input.prompt: A single square modern processor package seen from the front at a gentle high angle, almost straight on, centred and filling the frame. Its substrate is burnt terracotta orange printed circuit board with fine gold traces and small components. In its centre one large square die window: smooth empty glossy black glass in a thin gold bezel, completely blank, taking about half the chip's width. Along the bottom edge of the substrate, one wide flat empty matte black label panel with a thin gold border, completely blank. In the top left corner a small flat empty square gold pad, blank; in the top right corner a small flat empty rectangular matte white label, blank. Gold pins along all four edges. Painted light: one strong warm golden key light from behind the chip casting broad golden rays upward, like a halo; a green rim light on the left edge, a red rim light on the right edge. Painted comic book illustration in exactly the style of the reference image (the green NVIDIA chip): a real object drawn sharp with clean black ink outlines on every part, comic halftone dots only inside the shadows, saturated colour. The object alone on a pure black void, seen clearly. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no symbols, no flags, no signs, no markings anywhere.
